title: Permio project configuration (permio.yaml)
description: Permissions, roles, groups and grants of one perms.io project, managed with `permio plan` and `permio apply`. Objects in the file are created or updated. A role's permissions, a group's members (when given) and a grant's roles and permissions are each the full set. With --prune, objects in the project that are not in the file are deleted.

project.description: The project this file describes. Defaults to the configured project (--project, PERMIO_PROJECT or the profile).

permissions.description: The project's permissions. Each is a name, or an object with a name and a description. A bare name leaves the description unchanged.

description.description: Omit to leave the description unchanged.

roles.description: Roles keyed by role name. Grants refer to roles by these names.

description.description: Omit to leave the description unchanged.

permissions.description: The role's full permission set. Each must be listed under permissions or already exist in the project.

groups.description: Groups keyed by slug. Grant to a group with the principal "group:<slug>".

description.description: Omit to leave the description unchanged.

members.description: The group's full member list (principal IDs). Omit to leave members unmanaged. Groups cannot contain groups.

grants.description: Grants. Each entry is the full set of roles and permissions for one (principal, resource) pair; list each pair once. Empty lists revoke everything on that pair.

principal.description: Principal ID: a user or service ID, or group:<slug>.

resource.description: Resource URI, e.g. /projects/123. The grant applies to it and everything below it; a "_" segment matches any one segment.

roles.description: Role names (from roles, or existing in the project).
